mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome to this journey—a journey that doesn’t really end when your kids become adults, but instead transforms into an entirely new adventure. Maybe you’ve found yourself wondering how to support your grown children as they face big decisions, form relationships, build careers, or wrestle with their own struggles. Even when they’re out in the world, making choices on their own, that deep desire to see them flourish never fades. Together, we’re about to explore how prayer can be the most powerful and loving way to stay connected to our adult children, no matter where life takes them. Drawing from Stormie Omartian’s heartfelt book, The Power of Praying for Your Adult Children, we’ll discover how prayer isn’t just a comfort—it can become a lifeline that supports, guides, and protects, even when we can’t be there in person. What if you could let go of worry, and trade it for faith and hope? As we dive into these insights, you’ll see how shifting from control to trust can open the door to a deeper spiritual connection—not just with your children, but within yourself as well. So, let’s take these next steps together. We’ll uncover ways to pray for the unique challenges your adult children face, find peace in the midst of uncertainty, and strengthen that unbreakable bond between parent and child. Ready? Let’s explore what it truly means to keep loving, guiding, and cheering for your children—no matter how grown up they are.
